description: This source lists measurements and model comparisons for brewery biogas recovery in Lleida, anaerobic treatment in Karmiel and Shafdan, distillery heat recovery in Tain, heat-recovery feasibility in Roussillon and joint wastewater-plant control in Kalundborg. Contents include COD, methane, polyphenol and membrane-pressure responses, energy consumption, heat-exchanger information and aeration set-point comparisons. The Kalundborg before/after comparison uses one year before control and three months extrapolated to a year afterward, with flow normalization. Sensor-failure periods are excluded from specified correlations. This document may overlap separately deposited study measurements, so independent samples and equivalent operating periods are not asserted. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
